cases.description: One admitted P0 item has an N1 MEX route with current machine, material, calibration, operator, inspection and post-repair evidence.
The CAD is available but manufacturing rights are unknown; the route must not be treated as authorized.
The appliance/product revision does not match the released part package.
The filament identity or lot is not established, so process suitability cannot be asserted.
A CNC route is offered for a part requiring material extrusion, and the machine envelope is outside the requirement.
A critical inspection instrument is past its calibration expiry.
The part's declared operating temperature exceeds the qualified route envelope.
A P3 protective component is requested at H0; household capability cannot admit it.
The route lacks the required dimensional inspection method and cannot release an accepted part.
The route is otherwise qualified but its lead time misses the required deadline.
The route can make the part, but a critical controller dependency is imported with no alternate source or local repair.
An imported machine is operational and can make the part, but its critical controller cannot be locally repaired or reproduced.
The N1 alternative has unknown material evidence, but a distinct R2 route has all mandatory evidence and is feasible.
A machine dependency graph contains a cycle; the existing machine can operate, but local reproduction closure remains unknown.
Two queued jobs require more units than the shared machine has available capacity for in the declared window.
The machine identity and safety qualification are unknown; successful operation cannot be presumed.
The rights holder has revoked the manufacturing permission.
Required post-repair verification is missing; the produced part cannot be released for installation.
A specialist process family is outside the v0.1 supported process model.
The process control safety state is explicitly unqualified; speed and cost cannot override this hard stop.

claim_ceiling: All inputs are synthetic. Expected outputs are provisional known-answer labels for independent review, not evidence of physical process qualification, machine safety, rights, local sourcing, cost savings or repair performance.
